messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD# REDIS-ACCEPT-QUEUE (severity: 2). accept_queue length > 800 on redis-cluster-usw2-prod. p99 Redis latency ~1.1s. Observed spike started ~5m ago. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/alerts/redis-acceptqueue

pagerduty: Page routed to SRE oncall: @sylvie-oncall (ack required)

sylvie-oncall: acked. pulling up dashboards. seeing corresponding postgresql waiters on pg-main-usw2, connection queueing at app-proxy layer. likely acceptqueue -> pgbouncer/pg backpressure loop.

raj-sre: on it. quick check: redis-master cpu ~85%, net in spike, accept_queue trending up across all shards not just 1. clients connected count normal. Could be bursty fanout or slow client ACKs.

jordan-db: noticed postgres active connections rising, pgbouncer pool exhausted in some app pods. pgbouncer stats: 
```
num_client_waiting: 120
current_server_connections: 480
max_server_connections: 500
```
This will cascade if we don't throttle upstream.

alice-platform: can we flip the circuit breaker on the heavy write route temporarily? /v1/generate has a lot of parallelism. I can set per-route concurrency to 40 for 10m.

sylvie-oncall: do that please. also let's reduce worker concurrency on the batcher job group. Greg, can you pause non-critical background workers?

greg-support: pausing export-worker queue now (graceful drain). `systemctl stop redwood-export` on the nodes with high client count.

raj-sre: scaling redis-proxy and pgbouncer horizontally now. commands: 
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/redis-proxy --replicas=4
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/pgbouncer --replicas=6
```
should take ~30-60s to attach. watching readiness.

incident-bot: k8s deploy redis-proxy scaled to 4 replicas (by raj-sre).

jordan-db: pgbouncer replicas coming up. but backlog still present; we need to reduce new incoming requests temporarily.

alice-platform: circuit-breaker updated on gateway: `concurrency_limit=40` for /v1/generate, rolling apply. throwing 429s to new requests above threshold.

raj-sre: observed accept_queue drop from ~820 -> ~220 in 90s. redis p99 latency down to 320ms. pg waiting connections decreasing. good sign.

sylvie-oncall: nice. set autoscale policy to keep extra pgbouncer replicas for next 30m to avoid flapping. I'll set a maintenance window.

alice-platform: autoscale updated: minReplicas=4, cooldown=300s for pgbouncer.

jordan-db: quick note — client retry storms can bring this back. we should add a short jitter backoff in the API client library. filing follow-up.

raj-sre: completed temporary mitigation checklist: scaled proxies, reduced concurrency, paused non-critical workers, circuit-breaker enabled. Moving to monitoring for ripple effects.

sylvie-oncall: calling customer-impact assessment: any 5xx or user-facing latency errors? Greg?

greg-support: support queue: ~12 API errors reported in last 10m, mostly 429s after CB flip. no major customer outages reported. tagging affected customers and sending notice.

pagerduty: PD# REDIS-ACCEPT-QUEUE acknowledged by sylvie-oncall at 6067891237. Escalation timer paused.

incident-bot: Alert suppressed for 10m (auto-squelch) per oncall action.

raj-sre: will keep an eye for 15m, then start rollback plan if stable. postmortem items: investigate origin of fanout (suspect batcher spikes), add redis accept_queue alert smoother, add client retry jitter.

jordan-db: also recommend increasing pgbouncer server_pool_size by 10% as medium-term. opening PR with metrics.

alice-platform: created infra ticket INFRA-3412 for circuit-breaker default on generate route and client library change.

sylvie-oncall: handing off monitoring and follow-ups to @raj-sre for the night. Summary: mitigations applied, accept_queue ↘, pg waiters ↘, minor 429s for excess requests, no major customer impact. Please run through the runbook if it spikes again.

raj-sre: taking handoff. I'll keep the extra replicas for 30m and then slowly scale down to baseline. ping me if alerts re-fire.

sylvie-oncall: thanks everyone — marking incident as in-progress -> mitigated. leaving an ACTIONS comment in the runbook. :thumbsup:

greg-support: leaving a short customer note and closing urgent tickets.

jordan-db: follow-up tasks assigned. will schedule post-incident review tomorrow.

pagerduty: PD# REDIS-ACCEPT-QUEUE status: mitigated (no further escalation).

incident-bot: Thread closed by sylvie-oncall at 6067891600."
